meta.source: MFI360 monthly scheme AUM + daily NAV (Vistas pack)
meta.identity: AUM_t = AUM_{t-1}*(1+r) + F ;  price_action = AUM_{t-1}*r ;  F = dAUM - price_action
meta.grain: one row per (scheme, month); vendor AUM is scheme-level repeated per plan -> deduplicated
meta.donor_primary: Regular Growth > Direct Growth > any Growth > any non-IDCW
meta.donor_alt: Direct Growth first (the flow_alt band edge; gap = expense-ratio drag)
meta.suspect_rule: |flow| > 50% of prior AUM and > Rs 500 cr, or |monthly NAV return| > 60% (merger / segregated portfolio / spliced NAV — flagged, not dropped)
caveats: Monthly only: AUM is a month-end figure.
The INDUSTRY total double-counts fund-of-funds (FoF AUM and the underlying scheme's AUM are both scheme-level AUM), so it runs above AMFI's headline; per-scheme and per-AMC are unaffected.
A scheme's first month is excluded, so NFO money is not counted as flow.
flow vs flow_alt is the Regular/Direct expense-drag band; the true value lies between. Read the band in absolute rupees, not percent.
